answer: Each identity claims one canyon plot and locks a 70-credit bond, then files a comet sort log: fragments from the comet shower, sorted by ember-glow assay into glass, stone, ash, checked against a strewn-field table. Auditors recompute plot totals from the table; a mismatch or reused key burns the bond. First plot 28 credits, kth 28+9(k-1); the 1000th costs 9019, and 1000 fake plots cost 4,523,500 plus 70,000 bonded. A rented-plot ring fails: one ember assay signature binds each plot key, and a second filing burns both bonds. Honest surveyors pay 28 once, bond back after a clean audit.
